name: Feature request / game adapter
about: Suggest a useful enhancement with realistic acceptance criteria
title: "[Feature] "
labels: ["enhancement"]
assignees: []
---

## User problem

What would you like to do and what is currently blocking you?

## Type

- [ ] Custom song packs / asset loader
- [ ] Local scores and leaderboard
- [ ] Multiplayer / lobbies
- [ ] HID diagnostics or cabinet IO
- [ ] Profiles / setup / display / audio
- [ ] New game-version adapter
- [ ] Other

## Target environment

- Game ID and precise revision (if known):
- Windows / cabinet type:
- Original or custom IO controller:
- Expected configuration / files:

## Proposal and acceptance tests

What would a successful, independently verifiable result look like? Include error cases and offline fallback.

## Availability of rights-cleared test data

Can you provide synthetic or self-authored fixtures **without** distributing protected game assets?

## Compatibility and safety

Explain what should happen when the game revision doesn't match, the network is unavailable or a device disconnects.
